PluginData.Tooltip: POC: requests exactly 1 kg of Ice into one tagged O2/H2 Generator every second.
PluginData.Description:
Proof-of-concept client plugin for Keen multiplayer testing.
Setup: - Rename one cargo container containing Ice so its name includes [IceSource]. - Rename one O2/H2 Generator so its name includes [IceTest]. - Keep both on the grid you are actively controlling from a cockpit or control seat. - The plugin disables Use Conveyor and Auto-Refill only on the [IceTest] generator. - Every second it requests an exact 1 kg Ice transfer through the normal inventory API. - It never intentionally sends a partial pulse when less than 1 kg is available. - The server remains authoritative and can reject a transfer request. - Diagnostics are written to %APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers\IcePulseTest.log.
This is a narrow inventory-transfer proof of concept, not a general Programmable Block script runner.
